cases.source_root_cause: Map creates the result via NewTypedArray using an input-derived type token, then uses that old token for FastSetPropertyByIndex. Upstream implementation shows NewTypedArray may invoke TypedArraySpeciesCreate on its slow path and writes a type-derived HClass on its fast path; FastSetPropertyByIndex consumes the JSType token when selecting typed-array write behavior. The callback runs after allocation and receives the source object as this, while the fresh result is not passed in the inspected call argument list. The fix samples type from the result array itself.

cases.CVE_or_advisory: No CVE/security advisory verified. Upstream patch commit message references issue I7KZJ7 (“CreateFromTypedArray byteLength data overflow”); direct issue page was inaccessible in this verification pass.
cases.root_cause: elementSize and elementLength are uint32_t; their product was assigned to uint32_t byteLength, which can wrap below the bytes required by elementLength. The result flows to AllocateArrayBuffer while the conversion loop still iterates elementLength and advances targetByteIndex by elementSize. The patch widens the multiplication/result to uint64_t. This supports an under-allocation/OOB-write concern; no dynamic impact was reproduced.
